mission_07: Congratulations on mastering multivariate time series forecasting! The VAR model you implemented captures the rich interdependencies between multiple time series, enabling more accurate forecasts when variables influence each other. Cross-correlation analysis revealed the temporal relationships between series, showing which variables lead or lag others. The Granger causality test provided a formal statistical framework for assessing whether one time series contains useful predictive information about another. These multivariate techniques are essential in economics, finance, and engineering where systems of interrelated variables must be modeled jointly. The recursive forecasting approach you implemented demonstrates how multivariate models naturally produce coherent forecasts across all variables simultaneously, preserving the correlation structure learned from historical data.
